instruction: Configure GIMP to enable fullscreen mode for the image window.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling fullscreen mode in GIMP. Uses existing check_config_status metric to verify fullscreen setting in sessionrc config file. Similar complexity to original - single display mode toggle.
